Surfaces.Contract: Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Name: stream-options-group-iterator
Boundaries.Contract: The iterator owns validation, key snapshot, cancellation and every group-read page from its first MoveNextAsync through terminal failure, completion or early disposal. Page dispatch borrows the iterator's failure-only lease.
